entry.title: Physics-Informed Surrogate Models for Engineering Simulation
entry.summary: We propose a physics-informed neural surrogate constrained by conservation laws and boundary conditions, targeting real-time engineering simulation. Experiments on 2D flow demonstrate the surrogate matches the high-fidelity solver within 3% relative error.

entry.title: On the Limits of Social Media Recommendation Algorithms
entry.summary: This paper studies the social and political effects of feed-ranking systems. We discuss engagement metrics, A/B test methodology, and policy implications.
